steps.message:
I checked before editing, and this one has a consequence beyond the line it touches.

`routes/users.js:6` is the only place `userId` appears, so the edit itself is one word. But it's a response field name on `GET /users`, and `README.md` records:

- Consumers: the web app, the iOS app (3.2 and later), and the nightly partner export.
- "Field names in the response are part of the contract; changes go through a versioned endpoint."

Renaming in place is a breaking change for every one of those clients — the iOS app in particular can't be updated in lockstep, and the nightly partner export would silently lose the field. It also contradicts the repo's stated policy of versioning contract changes.

I haven't made any change yet.
